public.title: Alien Dictionary
public.description: Words are sorted under an unknown alphabet order. Return the lexicographically smallest valid alphabet string containing every distinct lowercase ASCII character present, or an empty string if no order works. A longer word appearing before its exact prefix is invalid. There are 0 to 100 words, each length 0 to 30.
hints: Only the first difference between neighboring words creates an ordering edge.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Topological sorting chooses the smallest currently available letter at every step, producing the lexicographically smallest order. Reject prefix contradictions and cycles.
